subject: Post-discovery: pick a 30m demo slot + stakeholder map
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@clearview.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 28 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: pick a 30m demo slot + stakeholder map

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our 30-minute discovery:
- Key priority: reduce per-query inference cost while preserving 95th-percentile latency under 200ms for short text features.
- Evaluation criteria: latency SLOs, throughput (batching), security (VPC/KMS), and integration points (S3 export + API triggers).
- Decision-makers: you (product), + security lead (TBD), + infra owner (TBD).

To keep momentum, can we lock a 30-minute product demo/technical deep dive next week? I proposed three candidate windows below (all PT):
1) Tue Jun 1 — 10:00–10:30 AM
2) Wed Jun 2 — 2:30–3:00 PM
3) Thu Jun 3 — 9:00–9:30 AM

Suggested attendees from our side: Marcus (technical owner) and Monica (CS lead). If you expect your security infra lead to join, note that Marcus can extend to a 45-min deep dive.

I attached a short summary of the discovery and a draft 30-min agenda. If none of the times fit, please pick up to two that work or send a preferred window (we can pivot). Also here's a one-click poll if you'd rather: https://tinyurl.com/clearview-demo-poll

Attachments: 2026-05-28_discovery-notes.pdf, MVP-priorities.xlsx

Next steps: Alex confirms preferred slot + list of internal attendees. We'll send calendar invite and a brief pre-read.

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@clearview.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 28 May 2026 09:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: pick a 30m demo slot + stakeholder map

Thanks Neha — appreciate the recap.

We can do Wed Jun 2 2:30–3:00 PM PT (option 2) — that works best for product and I can pull in our security lead (Tanya Rao) for the first 20 minutes. If Tanya wants to stay longer we'll be fine.

A couple of asks before the demo:
- Can Marcus include a slide or 5-minute run showing how KV cache + prefix caching would map to our current ingestion?
- Would be great to see real token-cost numbers for a ~1M monthly query workload.

I'll confirm Tanya once she accepts on my side.

Alex Chen
Director, Product | Clearview Analytics
alex.chen@clearview.ai | (650) 555-9988
